# TypeScript Gotchas

> Known TypeScript patterns that bypass type safety or produce unexpected runtime behavior. Load all HIGH entries before writing any TypeScript.

## Entries

- [Type assertions with as](type-assertions.md): as bypasses the type checker entirely -- TypeScript trusts you unconditionally. Use type guards, satisfies, or instanceof instead for safe narrowing. HIGH.
- [Optional chaining vs nullish coalescing](nullish.md): ?. returns undefined on a missing property (does not throw). ?? only catches null and undefined -- it does NOT catch 0, empty string, or false. MEDIUM.
- [Pin Drizzle ORM to ^0.45.x](drizzle-version-pinning.md): v1.0.0-beta has breaking migration folder structure changes. Stay on 0.45.x until a deliberate upgrade window. HIGH.
- [Vitest jsdom requires separate install](vitest-jsdom.md): environment: "jsdom" in vitest.config.ts fails unless jsdom is installed as a devDependency. MEDIUM.
- [Vite $lib alias needs vite.config.ts](vite-lib-alias.md): Path alias in tsconfig.json only is not enough -- Vite/Rollup needs it in vite.config.ts resolve.alias too. MEDIUM.
- [Biome 2.x config format changed](biome-config-migration.md): organizeImports, files.ignore, and folder patterns all changed. Run npx biome migrate --write. MEDIUM.
- [Cascading import breakage on module deletion](cascading-import-breakage.md): Deleting modules causes chain-reaction build failures far beyond the listed files. Trace full import graph before deleting. HIGH.
- [SQL parameter index off-by-one in dynamic UPDATE builders](sql-parameter-index-off-by-one.md): Dynamic SET clause with appended fields shifts WHERE clause indices. Query executes without error but matches zero rows. Silent data loss. HIGH.
- [Date-only strings parse as UTC, off-by-one in local timezone](date-only-utc-off-by-one.md): new Date("2026-01-15") is UTC midnight; Intl.DateTimeFormat shows previous day in US timezones. MEDIUM.
- [Async singleton race condition](async-singleton-race.md): Guarding async singleton with null check on resolved value lets concurrent callers create duplicate instances. Store the promise, not the value. HIGH.
- [TypeScript 6 peer dep conflict with typescript-eslint](ts6-peer-dep-conflict.md): typescript-eslint 8.x requires typescript <6.0.0. Upgrading to TS 6 breaks npm ci in Docker/CI. Add legacy-peer-deps=true to .npmrc as a bridge. HIGH.
- [drizzle-kit migrate silently skips older when timestamps](drizzle-kit-migrate-silent-skip.md): drizzle-kit applies migrations by the when field in _journal.json, not file order. Newly generated migrations with when below the existing ceiling are skipped silently with a misleading success message. HIGH.
- [TS type predicate parameter-type assignability](type-predicate-assignability.md): User-defined predicates (x): x is T fail with TS2677 if T is not assignable to the parameter type. Common with Drizzle nullable left joins. MEDIUM.
- [drizzle-kit silent "no schema changes" when new schema file is missing from config](drizzle-kit-schema-not-in-config.md): drizzle-kit only inspects the explicit schema paths in drizzle.config.ts -- not the barrel re-exports. Forgetting to add a new schema file path silently produces an empty migration with the "No schema changes, nothing to migrate" message. HIGH.
- [Audit table FK to primary entity blocks pre-activation events](audit-table-fk-lifecycle.md): Audit tables that NOT NULL FK to a primary entity cannot record request -> approve -> activate lifecycle events. Decide upfront: parallel log channel, nullable FK, or split request + audit tables. MEDIUM.
- [Vitest mocks of Drizzle queries need a thenable .where()](vitest-drizzle-thenable-mock.md): Drizzle queries are thenables; if production code does `await db.select().from(t).where(cond)` without `.limit()`, mocks that only stub `.limit()` cause "rows is not iterable" far from the mock. Make `.where()` return both a `then`-able and a `.limit()`. HIGH.
- [pnpm overrides need an exact version to force re-resolution](pnpm-overrides-exact-version.md): Range-style overrides (e.g. ">=8.0.5") in pnpm.overrides act as peer-dep constraints, not forced re-resolution. Vulnerable transitives stay locked unless you pin to an exact version. HIGH.

- [`ALTER COLUMN ... SET NOT NULL` fails on existing NULL rows](drizzle-set-not-null-needs-backfill.md): drizzle-kit emits SET NOT NULL without a backfill UPDATE. Hand-edit the generated SQL to add `UPDATE x SET col = default WHERE col IS NULL` before the SET NOT NULL. HIGH.
- [vitest queue-shifting DB mocks break when guards add new DB calls](vitest-queue-shift-mocks-need-stubs-for-new-guard-hops.md): Adding a lifecycle/feature/audit check to a shared guard consumes a queue slot in unrelated route tests. Stub the new dep separately so it short-circuits. MEDIUM.
- [Migrating a function from sync to async silently breaks `if (!x)` guards](sync-to-async-truthy-check.md): After a function becomes Promise-returning, `const x = fn(); if (!x)` is always false because a Promise is truthy. tsc does not catch it; the not-found branch becomes dead code. Audit every caller. HIGH.
